title: Partial Thrift writes after bounded TCP batching rollout
fault_primitive: Lua TCP send batching drops the final partial batch
incident_class: Transport optimization regression causing size-dependent incomplete RPC requests
symptoms: Pods remain Ready. Larger compose RPCs stall; frontend emits TCP read timeouts and generic Thrift exceptions. Small timeline RPCs work, but blocked requests reduce throughput.
why_hard: The timeout is on receive although the defect is on send. Backend handlers never receive complete requests. Failure depends on serialized size including tracing metadata. The Deployment is unchanged; rollback cannot revert the startup ConfigMap. Restart, scaling and cache clearing preserve the algorithm. Diagnosis requires recognizing missing residual TCP bytes.
expected_agent_pitfalls: Investigating backend dependencies for frontend receive timeouts
Increasing read timeouts or pool sizes
Rolling back Deployments without repairing the startup ConfigMap
Checking only small RPCs or TCP connectivity
mitigation_summary: Change send batch count from floor to ceil in nginx startup Lua and recreate frontend pods.
